item.title: Winbond sees tighter memory supply and bigger expansion payoff ahead
item.summary: Winbond Electronics said rising prices and stronger shipments lifted its operating margin to 48.4% in the second quarter of 2026, and it expects the third-quarter margin to top 50%, setting a new high. The company also plans a major expansion in Kaohsiung as customers seek long-term supply through 2029 and 2030.
